inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.11.0: the same 86 files. The naming chunk changes its pattern and reads a slash pair's two sides, under a new hashed name that the entry files and declarations import; the symbols declarations change one doc comment; package.json and the feature manifest change only the version; CHANGELOG.md and README.md gain the 5.11.1 notes. The export map, stylesheet, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, theme manifest and REST description are unchanged.

ownerWaiver.question: Do you waive manual accessibility and per-browser acceptance for Quick Charts 5.11.1 (tarball sha256 c9f7f079...8335b), as for 5.11.0, and approve me tagging v5.11.1, dispatching release.yml and approving npm-publish through the API once the app's first-host CI passes?
ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Same terms as 5.11.0. The release records your waiver word for word.
